mapper.select: SELECT id, floor_plan_id, created_by, current_version_id, title, description, created_at FROM layouts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM layouts WHERE id = #{layoutId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM layout_versions WHERE layout_id = #{layoutId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) FROM layouts l INNER JOIN layout_zones z ON z.layout_version_id = l.current_version_id AND z.assigned_user_id = #{userId}
WHERE l.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
SELECT id, name, image_url, width, height FROM floor_plans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, layout_id, version, status, optimistic_lock, created_at FROM layout_versions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, layout_id, version, status, optimistic_lock, created_at FROM layout_versions WHERE layout_id = #{layoutId} ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT id, layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, display_order FROM walls WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO floor_plans (name, image_url, width, height) VALUES (#{name}, #{imageUrl}, #{width}, #{height})
INSERT INTO layouts (floor_plan_id, created_by, title, description) VALUES (#{floorPlanId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{description})
INSERT INTO layout_versions (layout_id, version, status, optimistic_lock) VALUES (#{layoutId}, #{version}, #{status}, #{optimisticLock})

INSERT INTO walls (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, display_order) VALUES
(#{wall.layoutVersionId}, #{wall.name}, #{wall.startX}, #{wall.startY}, #{wall.endX}, #{wall.endY}, COALESCE(#{wall.displayOrder}, 0))

INSERT INTO pillars (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, rotation, display_order) VALUES
